pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

2. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

4. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. goes

5. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

6. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.

7. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.

8. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

9. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.

10. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

12. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

13. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

14. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
   D. blue

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
